trs.20: O you who covers himself [with a garment],<sup foot_note=197644>1</sup>
trs.85: You, wrapped in your cloak,
trs.22: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
trs.203: O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) enveloped in garments!

trs.20: Arise and warn.
trs.85: arise and give warning!
trs.22: Arise and deliver thy warning!
trs.203: Arise and warn!

trs.20: And your Lord glorify.
trs.85: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;
trs.22: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
trs.203: And magnify your Lord (Allâh)!

trs.20: And your clothing purify.
trs.85: cleanse yourself;
trs.22: And thy garments keep free from stain!
trs.203: And purify your garments!

trs.20: And uncleanliness<sup foot_note=197645>1</sup> avoid.
trs.85: keep away from all filth;
trs.22: And all abomination shun!
trs.203: And keep away from Ar-Rujz (the idols)!

trs.20: And do not confer favor to acquire more<sup foot_note=197646>1</sup>.
trs.85: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;
trs.22: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
trs.203: And give not a thing in order to have more (or consider not your deeds of obedience to Allâh as a favour to Him).

trs.20: But for your Lord be patient.
trs.85: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.
trs.22: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
trs.203: And be patient for the sake of your Lord (i.e. perform your duty to Allâh)!

trs.20: And when the trumpet is blown,
trs.85: When the Trumpet sounds,
trs.22: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
trs.203: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded (i.e. the second blowing of the horn).

trs.20: That Day will be a difficult day
trs.85: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.
trs.22: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
trs.203: Truly, that Day will be a Hard Day -

trs.20: For the disbelievers - not easy.
trs.85: They will have no ease.
trs.22: Far from easy for those without Faith.
trs.203: Far from easy for the disbelievers.

trs.20: Leave Me with the one I created alone<sup foot_note=197647>1</sup>
trs.85: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,
trs.22: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
trs.203: Leave Me Alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely (without any wealth or children etc, i.e. Al-Walîd bin Al-Mughîrah Al-Makhzûmî)!

trs.20: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
trs.85: then gave vast wealth,
trs.22: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
trs.203: And then granted him resources in abundance.

trs.20: And children present [with him]
trs.85: and sons by his side,
trs.22: And sons to be by his side!-
trs.203: And children to be by his side.

trs.20: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
trs.85: making everything easy for him––
trs.22: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
trs.203: And made life smooth and comfortable for him.

trs.20: Then he desires that I should add more.
trs.85: yet he still hopes I will give him more.
trs.22: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
trs.203: After all that he desires that I should give more;

trs.20: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
trs.85: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:
trs.22: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
trs.203: Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations).

trs.20: I will cover him with arduous torment.
trs.85: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.
trs.22: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
trs.203: I shall oblige him to (climb a slippery mountain in the Hell-fire called As-Sa‘ûd, or) face a severe torment!

trs.20: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.<sup foot_note=197648>1</sup>
trs.85: He planned and plotted––
trs.22: For he thought and he plotted;-
trs.203: Verily, he thought and plotted.

trs.20: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
trs.85: devilishly he plotted!
trs.22: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
trs.203: So let him be cursed: how he plotted!

trs.20: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
trs.85: ferociously he plotted!––
trs.22: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
trs.203: And once more let him be cursed: how he plotted!

trs.20: Then he considered [again];
trs.85: and looked
trs.22: Then he looked round;
trs.203: Then he thought.

trs.20: Then he frowned and scowled;
trs.85: and frowned and scowled
trs.22: Then he frowned and he scowled;
trs.203: Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;

trs.20: Then he turned back and was arrogant
trs.85: and turned away and behaved arrogantly
trs.22: Then he turned back and was haughty;
trs.203: Then he turned back, and was proud.

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ

trs.20: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
trs.85: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,
trs.22: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
trs.203: Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old,

trs.20: This is not but the word of a human being."
trs.85: just the talk of a mortal!’
trs.22: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
trs.203: "This is nothing but the word of a human being!"

trs.20: I will drive him into Saqar.<sup foot_note=197649>1</sup>
trs.85: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.
trs.22: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
trs.203: I will cast him into Hell-fire.<sup foot_note=155018>1</sup>

trs.20: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
trs.85: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?
trs.22: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
trs.203: And what will make you know (exactly) what Hell-fire is?

trs.20: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
trs.85: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;
trs.22: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
trs.203: It spares not (any sinner), nor does it leave (anything unburnt)!

trs.20: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
trs.85: it scorches the flesh of humans;
trs.22: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
trs.203: Burning and blackening the skins!

trs.20: Over it are nineteen [angels].
trs.85: there are nineteen in charge of it––
trs.22: Over it are Nineteen.
trs.203: Over it are nineteen (angels as guardians and keepers of Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

trs.20: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
trs.85: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.
trs.22: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
trs.203: And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire. And We have fixed their number (19) only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may arrive at a certainty [that this Qur’ân is the truth as it agrees with their Books regarding the number (19) which is written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] and that the believers may increase in Faith (as this Qur’ân is the truth), and that no doubt may be left for the people of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy) and the disbelievers may say: "What Allâh intends by this (curious) example ?" Thus Allâh leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this (Hell) is nothing else than a (warning) reminder to mankind.

trs.20: No! By the moon.
trs.85: Yes––by the moon!
trs.22: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
trs.203: Nay! And by the moon

trs.20: And [by] the night when it departs.
trs.85: By the departing night!
trs.22: And by the Night as it retreateth,
trs.203: And by the night when it withdraws.

trs.20: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
trs.85: By the shining dawn!
trs.22: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
trs.203: And by the dawn when it brightens.

trs.20: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].
trs.85: It is one of the mightiest things,
trs.22: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
trs.203: Verily, it (Hell, or their denial of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, or the Day of Resurrection) is but one of the greatest (signs).

trs.20: As a warning to humanity -
trs.85: a warning to all mortals,
trs.22: A warning to mankind,-
trs.203: A warning to mankind -

verses.text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

trs.20: To whoever wills among you to proceed<sup foot_note=197650>1</sup> or stay behind.
trs.85: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.
trs.22: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
trs.203: To any of you that chooses to go forward (by working righteous deeds), or to remain behind (by committing sins).

trs.20: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained<sup foot_note=197651>1</sup>.
trs.85: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,
trs.22: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
trs.203: Every person is a pledge for what he has earned,

trs.20: Except the companions of the right,<sup foot_note=197652>1</sup>.
trs.85: but the Companions of the Right will stay
trs.22: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
trs.203: Except those on the Right, (i.e. the pious true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

trs.20: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
trs.85: in Gardens and ask
trs.22: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
trs.203: In Gardens (Paradise) they will ask one another,

trs.20: About the criminals,
trs.85: about the guilty.
trs.22: And (ask) of the Sinners:
trs.203: About Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, disbelievers), (And they will say to them):

trs.20: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
trs.85: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]
trs.22: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
trs.203: "What has caused you to enter Hell?"

trs.20: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
trs.85: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;
trs.22: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
trs.203: They will say: "We were not of those who used to offer the Salât (prayers),<sup foot_note=155019>1</sup>

trs.20: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
trs.85: we did not feed the poor;
trs.22: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
trs.203: "Nor we used to feed Al-Miskîn (the poor);

trs.20: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
trs.85: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];
trs.22: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
trs.203: "And we used to talk falsehood (all that which Allâh hated) with vain talkers.<sup foot_note=155020>1</sup>

trs.20: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
trs.85: we denied the Day of Judgement
trs.22: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
trs.203: And we used to belie the Day of Recompense,<sup foot_note=155021>1</sup>

trs.20: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
trs.85: until the Certain End came upon us.’
trs.22: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
trs.203: "Until there came to us (the death) that is certain."

trs.20: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
trs.85: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.
trs.22: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
trs.203: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.

trs.20: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.
trs.85: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,
trs.22: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
trs.203: Then what is wrong with them (i.e. the polytheists, the disbelievers) that they turn away from (receiving) admonition?

trs.20: As if they were alarmed donkeys.
trs.85: like frightened asses
trs.22: As if they were affrighted asses,
trs.203: As if they were (frightened) wild donkeys.

trs.20: Fleeing from a lion?
trs.85: fleeing from a lion?
trs.22: Fleeing from a lion!
trs.203: Fleeing from a hunter, or a lion, or a beast of prey.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً

trs.20: Rather, every person among them desires that he<sup foot_note=197654>1</sup> would be given scriptures spread about.<sup foot_note=197653>2</sup>
trs.85: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-
trs.22: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
trs.203: Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out (coming from Allâh with a writing that Islâm is the right religion, and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم has come with the truth from Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and earth).

trs.20: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
trs.85: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-
trs.22: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
trs.203: Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter (from Allâh’s punishment).

trs.20: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.
trs.85: but truly this is a reminder.
trs.22: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
trs.203: Nay, verily, this (Qur’an) is an admonition,

trs.20: Then whoever wills will remember it.
trs.85: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:
trs.22: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
trs.203: So whosoever will (let him read it), and receive admonition (from it)!

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ

trs.20: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
trs.85: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
trs.22: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
trs.203: And they will not receive admonition unless Allâh wills; He (Allâh) is the One, deserving that mankind should be afraid of, and should be dutiful to Him, and should not take any Ilâh (god) along with Him, and He is the One Who forgives (sins).
